title: glossoloma purpureum

This plant is native to the Andean region of South America and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
